name: envEnabled
description: The environment flags that this unit can function in. If the env matches any of these, it will be enabled.

name: envDisabled
description: The environment flags that this unit *cannot* function in. If the env matches any of these, it will explode or be disabled.

name: speed
description: movement speed (world units/t)

name: boostMultiplier
description: multiplier for speed when boosting

name: floorMultiplier
description: how affected this unit is by terrain

name: rotateSpeed
description: body rotation speed in degrees/t

name: baseRotateSpeed
description: mech base rotation speed in degrees/t

name: drag
description: movement drag as fraction

name: accel
description: acceleration as fraction of speed

name: hitSize
description: size of one side of the hitbox square

name: deathShake
description: shake on unit death

name: stepShake
description: shake on each step for leg/mech units

name: rippleScale
description: ripple / dust size for legged units

name: riseSpeed
description: boosting rise speed as fraction

name: descentSpeed
description: boosting descent speed as fraction

name: fallSpeed
description: how fast this unit falls upon death

name: missileAccelTime
description: how many ticks it takes this missile to accelerate to full speed

name: health
description: raw health amount

name: armor
description: incoming damage is reduced by this amount

name: range
description: minimum range of any weapon; used for approaching targets. can be overridden by setting a value > 0.

name: maxRange
description: maximum range of any weapon

name: mineRange
description: range at which this unit can mine ores

name: buildRange
description: range at which this unit can build

name: circleTargetRadius
description: radius for circleTarget, if true

name: crashDamageMultiplier
description: multiplier for damage this (flying) unit deals when crashing on enemy things

name: wreckHealthMultiplier
description: multiplier for health that this flying unit has for its wreck, based on its max health.

name: dpsEstimate
description: a VERY ROUGH estimate of unit DPS; initialized in init()

name: clipSize
description: graphics clipping size; <0 to calculate automatically

name: drownTimeMultiplier
description: multiplier for how slowly this unit drowns - higher numbers, slower drowning.

name: strafePenalty
description: fractional movement speed penalty for this unit when it is moving in the opposite direction that it is facing

name: researchCostMultiplier
description: multiplier for cost of research in tech tree

name: groundLayer
description: for ground units, the layer upon which this unit is drawn

name: flyingLayer
description: For units that fly, the layer upon which this unit is drawn. If no value is set, defaults to Layer.flyingUnitLow or Layer.flyingUnit depending on lowAltitude

name: payloadCapacity
description: Payload capacity of this unit in world units^2

name: buildSpeed
description: building speed multiplier; <0 to disable.

name: aimDst
description: Minimum distance from this unit that weapons can target. Prevents units from firing "inside" the unit.

name: buildBeamOffset
description: Visual offset of the build beam from the front.

name: mineBeamOffset
description: Visual offset of the mining beam from the front. Defaults to half the hitsize.

name: targetPriority
description: WIP: Units of low priority will always be ignored in favor of those with higher priority, regardless of distance.

name: shadowElevation
description: Elevation of shadow drawn under this (ground) unit. Visual only.

name: shadowElevationScl
description: Scale for length of shadow drawn under this unit. Does nothing if this unit has no shadow.

name: engineOffset
description: backwards engine offset from center of unit

name: engineSize
description: main engine radius

name: engineLayer
description: layer of all engines (<0 for default)

name: itemOffsetY
description: visual backwards offset of items on unit

name: lightRadius
description: radius of light emitted, <0 for default

name: lightOpacity
description: light color opacity

name: softShadowScl
description: scale of soft shadow - its size is calculated based off of region size

name: fogRadius
description: fog view radius in tiles. <0 for automatic radius.

name: waveTrailX
description: horizontal offset of wave trail in naval units

name: waveTrailY
description: vertical offset of wave trail in naval units

name: trailScl
description: width of all trails (including naval ones)

name: isEnemy
description: if true, this unit counts as an enemy in the wave counter (usually false for support-only units)

name: flying
description: if true, the unit is always at elevation 1

name: wobble
description: whether this flying unit should wobble around

name: targetAir
description: whether this unit tries to attack air units

name: targetGround
description: whether this unit tries to attack ground units

name: faceTarget
description: if true, this unit will attempt to face its target when shooting/aiming at it

name: circleTarget
description: AI flag: if true, this flying unit circles around its target like a bomber

name: autoDropBombs
description: AI flag: if true, this unit will drop bombs under itself even when it is not next to its 'real' target. used for carpet bombers

name: targetBuildingsMobile
description: For the mobile version only: If false, this unit will not auto-target buildings to attach when a player controls it.

name: canBoost
description: if true, this unit can boost into the air if a player/processors controls it

name: boostWhenBuilding
description: if true, this unit will always boost when using builder AI

name: boostWhenMining
description: if true, this unit will always boost when using miner AI

name: logicControllable
description: if false, logic processors cannot control this unit

name: playerControllable
description: if false, players cannot control this unit

name: controlSelectGlobal
description: If true, the unit can be selected with the global selection hotkey (shift+g).

name: allowedInPayloads
description: if false, this unit cannot be moved into payloads

name: hittable
description: if false, this unit cannot be hit by bullets or explosions

name: killable
description: if false, this unit does not take damage and cannot be kill() / destroy()-ed.

name: targetable
description: if false, this unit is not targeted by anything.

name: vulnerableWithPayloads
description: if true, this unit can be hit/targeted when it has payloads (assuming hittable/targetable is false)

name: pickupUnits
description: if true, this payload unit can pick up units

name: physics
description: if false, this unit does not physically collide with others.

name: canDrown
description: if true, this ground unit will drown in deep liquids.

name: useUnitCap
description: if false, this unit ignores the unit cap and can be spawned infinitely

name: coreUnitDock
description: if true, this core unit will "dock" to other units, making it re-appear when "undocking".

name: createWreck
description: if false, no falling "corpse" is created when this unit dies.

name: createScorch
description: if false, no scorch marks are created when this unit dies

name: lowAltitude
description: if true, this unit will be drawn under effects/bullets; this is a visual change only.

name: rotateToBuilding
description: if true, this unit will look at whatever it is building

name: allowLegStep
description: if true and this is a legged unit, this unit can walk over blocks.

name: legPhysicsLayer
description: for legged units, setting this to false forces it to be on the ground physics layer.

name: hovering
description: if true, this unit will not be affected by the floor under it.

name: omniMovement
description: if true, this unit can move in any direction regardless of rotation. if false, this unit can only move in the direction it is facing.

name: rotateMoveFirst
description: if true, the unit faces its moving direction before actually moving.

name: healFlash
description: if true, this unit flashes when being healed

name: canHeal
description: whether the unit can heal blocks. Initialized in init()

name: singleTarget
description: if true, all weapons will attack the same target.

name: forceMultiTarget
description: if true, this unit will be able to have multiple targets, even if it only has one mirrored weapon.

name: canAttack
description: if false, this unit has no weapons that can attack.

name: hidden
description: if true, this unit won't show up in the database or various other UIs.

name: internal
description: if true, this unit is for internal use only and does not have a sprite generated.

name: internalGenerateSprites
description: For certain units, generating sprites is still necessary, despite being internal.

name: bounded
description: If false, this unit is not pushed away from map edges.

name: naval
description: if true, this unit is detected as naval - do NOT assign this manually! Initialized in init()

name: autoFindTarget
description: if false, RTS AI controlled units do not automatically attack things while moving. This is automatically assigned.

name: targetUnderBlocks
description: If false, 'under' blocks like conveyors are not targeted.

name: alwaysShootWhenMoving
description: if true, this unit will always shoot while moving regardless of slowdown

name: hoverable
description: whether this unit has a hover tooltip

name: alwaysCreateOutline
description: if true, this modded unit always has a -outline region generated for its base. Normally, outlines are ignored if there are no top = false weapons.

name: generateFullIcon
description: for vanilla content only - if false, skips the full icon generation step.

name: squareShape
description: if true, this unit has a square shadow.

name: drawBuildBeam
description: if true, this unit will draw its building beam towards blocks.

name: drawMineBeam
description: if true, this unit will draw its mining beam towards blocks

name: drawCell
description: if false, the team indicator/cell is not drawn.

name: drawItems
description: if false, carried items are not drawn.

name: drawShields
description: if false, the unit shield (usually seen in waves) is not drawn.

name: drawBody
description: if false, the unit body is not drawn.

name: drawSoftShadow
description: if false, the soft shadow is not drawn.

name: drawMinimap
description: if false, the unit is not drawn on the minimap.

name: aiController
description: The default AI controller to assign on creation.

name: controller
description: Function that chooses AI controller based on unit entity.

name: constructor
description: Creates a new instance of this unit class.

name: abilities
description: list of "abilities", which are various behaviors that update each frame

name: weapons
description: All weapons that this unit will shoot with.

name: immunities
description: None of the status effects in this set can be applied to this unit.

name: healColor
description: color that this unit flashes when getting healed (if healFlash is true)

name: lightColor
description: Color of light that this unit produces when lighting is enabled in the map.

name: shieldColor
description: override for unit shield colour.

name: deathSound
description: sound played when this unit explodes (*not* when it is shot down)

name: deathSoundVolume
description: volume of death sound

name: wreckSound
description: sound played when the unit wreck is shot down

name: wreckSoundVolume
description: volume of wreck falling sound

name: loopSound
description: sound played on loop when this unit is around.

name: loopSoundVolume
description: volume of loop sound

name: stepSound
description: sound played when this mech/insect unit does a step

name: stepSoundVolume
description: volume of step sound

name: stepSoundPitch
description: base pitch of step sound

name: stepSoundPitchRange
description: pitch range variance for step sound

name: tankMoveSound
description: sound looped when tank moves

name: moveSound
description: sound looped when the unit moves; volume depends on velocity

name: moveSoundVolume
description: volume of movement sound

name: moveSoundPitchMin
description: minimum pitch of movement sound based on velocity

name: moveSoundPitchMax
description: maximum pitch of movement sound based on velocity

name: tankMoveVolume
description: volume of tank move sfx

name: fallEffect
description: effect that this unit emits when falling

name: fallEngineEffect
description: effect created at engine when unit falls.

name: deathExplosionEffect
description: effect created when this unit dies

name: treadEffect
description: optional effect created when this tank moves

name: parts
description: extra (usually animated) visual parts

name: engines
description: list of engines, or "thrusters"

name: useEngineElevation
description: if false, the thruster is always displayed at its normal size regardless of elevation

name: engineColor
description: override for all engine colors

name: engineColorInner
description: color for inner portions of engines

name: trailLength
description: length of engine trail (if flying) or wave trail (if naval)

name: trailColor
description: override for engine trail color

name: flowfieldPathType
description: Cost type ID for flow field/enemy AI pathfinding.

name: pathCost
description: Function used for calculating cost of moving with ControlPathfinder. Does not affect "normal" flow field pathfinding.

name: pathCostId
description: ID for path cost, to be used in the control path finder. This is the value that actually matters; do not assign manually. Set in init().

name: sample
description: A sample of the unit that this type creates. Do not modify!

name: targetFlags
description: Flags to target based on priority. Null indicates that the closest target should be found. The closest enemy core is used as a fallback.

name: allowChangeCommands
description: A value of false is used to hide command changing UI in unit factories.

name: commands
description: Commands available to this unit through RTS controls. An empty array means commands will be assigned based on unit capabilities in init().

name: defaultCommand
description: Command to assign to this unit upon creation. Null indicates the first command in the array.

name: stances
description: Stances this unit can have.  An empty array means stances will be assigned based on unit capabilities in init().

name: outlineColor
description: color for outline generated around sprites

name: outlineRadius
description: thickness for sprite outline

name: outlines
description: if false, no sprite outlines are generated

name: itemCapacity
description: amount of items this unit can carry; <0 to determine based on hitSize.

name: ammoCapacity
description: @deprecated only kept for compatibility with some turrets that query this field! Remove this from your code immediately!

name: mineTier
description: max hardness of ore that this unit can mine (<0 to disable)

name: mineSpeed
description: mining speed in weird arbitrary units

name: mineWalls
description: whether this unit can mine ores from floors/walls, respectively

name: mineFloor
description: whether this unit can mine ores from floors/walls, respectively

name: mineHardnessScaling
description: if true, harder materials will take longer to mine

name: mineSound
description: continuous sound emitted when mining.

name: mineSoundVolume
description: volume of mining sound.

name: mineItems
description: Target items to mine. Used in MinerAI

name: legCount
description: number of legs this unit has (must have the correct type to function!)

name: legGroupSize
description: size of groups in which legs move. for example, insects (6 legs) usually move legs in groups of 3.

name: legLength
description: total length of a leg (both segments)

name: legSpeed
description: how fast individual legs move towards their destination (non-linear)

name: legForwardScl
description: scale for how far in front (relative to unit velocity) legs try to place themselves; if legs lag behind a unit, increase this number

name: legBaseOffset
description: leg offset from the center of the unit

name: legMoveSpace
description: scaling for space between leg movements

name: legExtension
description: for legs without "joints", this is how much the second leg sprite is moved "back" by, so it covers the joint region (it's hard to explain without an image)

name: legPairOffset
description: Higher values of this field make groups of legs move less in-sync with each other.

name: legLengthScl
description: scaling for how far away legs *try* to be from the body (not their actual length); e.g. if set to 0.5, legs will appear somewhat folded

name: legStraightLength
description: if legStraightness > 0, this is the scale for how far away legs are from the body horizontally

name: legMaxLength
description: maximum length of an individual leg as fraction of real length

name: legMinLength
description: minimum length of an individual leg as fraction of real length

name: legSplashDamage
description: splash damage dealt when a leg touches the ground

name: legSplashRange
description: splash damage radius of legs

name: baseLegStraightness
description: how straight the leg base/origin is (0 = circular, 1 = line)

name: legStraightness
description: how straight the leg outward angles are (0 = circular, 1 = horizontal line)

name: legBaseUnder
description: If true, the base (further away) leg region is drawn under instead of over.

name: lockLegBase
description: If true, legs are locked to the base of the unit instead of being on an implicit rotating "mount".

name: legContinuousMove
description: If true, legs always try to move around even when the unit is not moving (leads to more natural behavior)

name: flipBackLegs
description: TODO neither of these appear to do much

name: flipLegSide
description: TODO neither of these appear to do much

name: emitWalkSound
description: Whether to emit a splashing noise in water.

name: emitWalkEffect
description: Whether to emit a splashing effect in water (fasle implies emitWalkSound false).

name: mechLandShake
description: screen shake amount for when this mech lands after boosting

name: mechSideSway
description: parameters for mech swaying animation

name: mechFrontSway
description: parameters for mech swaying animation

name: mechStride
description: parameters for mech swaying animation

name: mechStepParticles
description: whether particles are created when this mech takes a step

name: mechLegColor
description: color that legs change to when moving, to simulate depth

name: treadRects
description: list of treads as rectangles in IMAGE COORDINATES, relative to the center. these are mirrored.

name: treadFrames
description: number of frames of movement in a tread

name: treadPullOffset
description: how much of a top part of a tread sprite is "cut off" relative to the pattern; this is corrected for

name: crushFragile
description: if true, 'fragile' blocks will instantly be crushed in a 1x1 area around the tank

name: segments
description: number of independent segments

name: segmentUnits
description: TODO wave support - for multi-unit segmented units, this is the number of independent units that are spawned

name: segmentUnit
description: unit spawned in segments; if null, the same unit is used

name: segmentEndUnit
description: unit spawned at the end; if null, the segment unit is used

name: segmentLayerOrder
description: true - parent segments are on higher layers; false - parent segments are on lower layers than head

name: segmentMag
description: magnitude of sine offset between segments

name: segmentScl
description: scale of sine offset between segments

name: segmentPhase
description: index multiplier of sine offset between segments

name: segmentRotSpeed
description: how fast each segment moves towards the next one

name: segmentMaxRot
description: maximum difference between segment angles

name: segmentSpacing
description: spacing between separate unit segments (only used for multi-unit worms)

name: segmentRotationRange
description: rotation between segments is clamped to this range

name: crawlSlowdown
description: speed multiplier this unit will have when crawlSlowdownFrac is met.

name: crushDamage
description: damage dealt to blocks under this tank/crawler every frame.

name: crawlSlowdownFrac
description: the fraction of solids under this block necessary for it to reach crawlSlowdown.

name: lifetime
description: lifetime of this missile.

name: homingDelay
description: ticks that must pass before this missile starts homing.
